week_level_decisions.goal: suggested-adjacency to driving host videos (see notes)
week_level_decisions.slots: publish at the CONCEPT'S intent time (morning concepts AM, evening/sleep PM). Slot is NOT a lever: last-2-weeks AM 156 v/d vs PM 149 (flat); impressions/day 3.3-4.3K and CTR ~3.2 identical across slots. The 6-week 'AM 241 vs PM 152' was four July AM CONCEPT wins (Cortisol Detox wave 526/d etc.), not slot.
week_level_decisions.cortisol_concentration: ONE cortisol ship (Tue hero) — not two, to avoid self-competition in the same pool
week_level_decisions.no_sleep_ship: deliberate pool-widening; 'Sleep Raga' benched as next fresh sleep lead
week_level_decisions.morning_cap: max 2 morning-CONCEPT ships this week (Tue, Wed) — no evidence all-morning beats a mixed week; concentration on one unproven pool is a correlated bet
week_level_decisions.scorecard_weekly_api: Suggested views/wk stop falling (w/w ≥0 two weeks running) · own-channel share of Suggested referrers ≥50% (now ~37%) · ≥2/5 ships ≥25% Suggested at d7 AND wk-2 ≥50% of wk-1 · PLAYLIST ≥10K/wk · Search ≥30K/wk floor
week_level_decisions.terminology_fix: 'SUBSCRIBER' traffic source = HOME FEED (96% what-to-watch; 95.7% of it non-subscribers). New ships get a ~3-day Home test (median ≈400 views) then withdraw unless picked up as a Suggested neighbour of a stable host.
